patchQueue.what: WEBCLAP_BUILD_DIR overrides the build directory in scripts/build-*.sh (default unchanged), so legacy and exnref builds sit side by side
-DWEBCLAP_EXNREF=ON adds -sWASM_LEGACY_EXCEPTIONS=0 (JUCE-kit ports via juce_webclap.cmake, and the Surge XT port); OFF by default; needs Emscripten >= 4.0.7
OB-Xf ui.wasm: link at -O1 when WEBCLAP_EXNREF=ON, because Binaryen 124 (Emscripten 4.0.20) SIGBUSes in StackIR optimisation on that module
